_comment: Example ZYAL SuperWorkflow that runs a governed Jailgun coding job end to end: research the task, produce N candidate solutions with Jailgun (same prompt across tabs), reduce to the best, review it for real-vs-fake work, gate, deploy over SSH, verify, and distill durable lessons. Authored in the flat supervisor shape so `jekko port-run --super` decodes it directly (no zyalc step needed for the per-phase `exec` field). Hosts/prompts are placeholders; override per run.
name: Jailgun governed coding run
objective: Drive a single coding objective through research, N-way Jailgun production, reduction, engineering review, gate, SSH deploy, verification, and durable memory without scope sprawl or vibe-coding shortcuts.

phases.name: Frame the objective
phases.objective: Restate the coding objective, success criteria, and the artifact contract; surface any project-scoped Negative lessons to avoid.

phases.name: Research first
phases.objective: Search the internet and the repo for prior art, APIs, and pitfalls relevant to the objective; produce a context brief.

phases.name: Produce candidates with Jailgun
phases.objective: Run the same prompt across N Jailgun tabs to produce candidate solutions (tar.gz -> deploy/CI), each an independent attempt.

exec.prompt: Implement the framed objective end to end with real tests. Follow the research brief; avoid the listed Negative lessons.

phases.name: Reduce to the best candidate
phases.objective: Compare the N Jailgun candidate receipts and select or merge the strongest one; record why the others were rejected.

phases.name: Engineering review
phases.objective: Review the reduced diff: real work vs fake tests vs over-engineering, with concrete references to files/lines. Emit a verdict.

phases.name: Verdict gate
phases.objective: Block the run when the review verdict rejects the work (fake tests / over-engineering / needs-rework); otherwise pass.

phases.name: Deploy over SSH
phases.objective: Push the approved candidate to the target host and run the fast-push/deploy command.

phases.name: Verify deploy + CI
phases.objective: Confirm the deploy landed and CI is green on the target host.

phases.name: Sign off + distill memory
phases.objective: Summarize the outcome and write durable Negative-memory capsules (project scope) for any approach that failed, so future runs avoid it.
